ab_drive.case: bid-heavy tight book, level timestamps 7200s old

decision_record.calculation: gate thresholds are the sleeve's own constants/cadence: 2x the 4h bar (basis), 1x the 3600s cadence (ENJ book), 5x the long-leg 10% liquidity gate (short leg), 10 calendar days for a daily bar (covers any long weekend/holiday gap)
decision_record.comparison: price-aware baseline = the sleeve's own pre-change rule evaluated on the same fixture (switch OFF drive)
decision_record.experiment: pre-registered A/B fixture drives in tests/test_enhance_batch15_blockers.py: ON refuses, OFF enters, fresh enters; fail direction proven (5 enhanced tests fail with the cure removed, pass restored)
decision_record.mechanism: refuse entries when the newest per-level Kraken book timestamp is >3600s (one cadence) old; the designed logic read only prices/sizes and ignored level timestamps, so a stale warm-cycle book fired a full-slice entry
decision_record.transfer: counterparties paying for immediacy/reversion on a live print keep the surplus only while the print is live; a stale print transfers the sleeve's capital to whoever holds the live side
